title: Three-Payment Settlement Call Window by Placement Stage
content:
# Three-Payment Settlement — Stage Shortening of the Call Window

The placement stage that a Placed Consumer Accounts record shows bears on the first-payment window when a consumer accepts a Three-Payment Settlement of Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements on a recorded call.

**Rule.** Where the account is at Legal Review Placement or Warehouse Placement, the Three-Payment call window is shortened by 3 days for its stage; where it is at Tertiary Placement or Secondary Placement, by 1 day; an account at Early-Out Placement or Primary Placement takes no stage shortening of the Three-Payment call window.

| Placement stage on the account | Stage shortening of the call window |
|---|---|
| Legal Review Placement | 3 days |
| Warehouse Placement | 3 days |
| Tertiary Placement | 1 day |
| Secondary Placement | 1 day |
| Primary Placement | none |
| Early-Out Placement | none |

## Basis Q&A

**Q. Is the stage read as of the offer or as the account stands?** The rule reads the stage at which the account is, as its record shows it.

**Q. Does a Warehouse Placement account lose more days than a Secondary Placement account?** Yes: 3 days against 1.
